prompt: I need an INI-style config parser for cfgtool. Put it in src/config.cpp + src/config.hpp. It has to handle [section] headers, key=value lines (trim whitespace around both sides), # and ; comments, and blank lines. Values can contain '=' so only split on the first one. Malformed lines get skipped but I need a count of them so the CLI can warn. Expose it as something like parse_config(std::istream&) returning the sections/keys plus that bad-line count. Tests in this repo are just plain asserts + ctest, no framework - the CMakeLists has the commented-out block showing the shape.
